title: Existence of normalized Cech comparison morphisms
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an open cover and hcover its covering proof. There exists a family of natural morphisms from Cech cohomology to sheaf cohomology in every degree satisfying the degree-zero normalization.

proof.text: Define the canonical degree-zero morphism at q = 0 and the zero morphism in every positive degree. Pattern matching on q gives the required family, and the q = 0 equation unfolds definitionally.

proof_origin.place: degree-zero canonical map and zero maps in positive degrees

theorem exists_cechComparisonSystem_comparison
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤) :
    ∃ comparison : ∀ q, TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyFunctor U q ⟶
      Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) q,
      comparison 0 =
        (TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyZeroIso U hcover).inv ≫
          (Sheaf.functorHZeroIso (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) isTerminalTop).inv
